coverage.summary: Covers all residential rental property in the City of San Diego, citywide. No unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits are stated.
coverage.other_conditions: Residential rental property takes the § 98.0702 definition: any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including units in a mobilehome park. Landlord also takes the § 98.0702 definition. Only the definitions are borrowed; the Division 7 exemptions in § 98.0703 (for example, the 15-year certificate-of-occupancy exemption) are not incorporated.

result.notes: The coverage values were left largely unchanged. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the rule reaches ordinary residential rental property, not a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify. The exclusions in § 98.1102 cover types of software, not buildings or units, so they are not listed as unverifiable_exemptions. One of them excludes affordable-housing-program rent-setting software. DX05, the codified Division 11, shows the ordinance was adopted as O-21955 N.S. on 5-22-2025, effective 6-21-2025. The rule's status of pending and its null effective date should therefore be updated. The enacted text also differs from the draft in three ways: the algorithmic device definition is narrowed to nonpublic competitor data 'of two or more landlords'; an appraisal-software exclusion (c) is added; and § 98.1104 adds landlord fee recovery and City enforcement. None of these changes affect building coverage.
